definitions.explanation: A chart or table laid out so that information can be found at a glance, such as conversions, fees, sizes, or schedules.

examples.japanese: {早見表|はやみひょう}で{確認|かくにん}する。
examples.english: Check it on the quick-reference chart.

examples.japanese: サイズの{早見表|はやみひょう}を{見|み}て{服|ふく}を{選|えら}んだ。
examples.english: I chose clothes by looking at the size chart.

examples.japanese: この{早見表|はやみひょう}を{使|つか}えば、{料金|りょうきん}がひと{目|め}で{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: With this quick-reference chart, you can tell the fee at a glance.

notes:
Composed of {早見|はやみ} (seeing quickly) + {表|ひょう} (table; chart). A {表|ひょう} arranged so an answer can be found at a glance, without calculation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料金|りょうきん}{早見表|はやみひょう}: a fee quick-reference chart
- {早見表|はやみひょう}を{作|つく}る: to make a quick-reference chart
- {早見表|はやみひょう}で{調|しら}べる: to look something up on a chart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一覧表|いちらんひょう}: a list/table — shows items together, not necessarily arranged for instant lookup
